headline: New security measures for the Dominican Republic Christmas Bonus
summary: The government announced new security measures against cloning, fraud and distribution irregularities for 1,320,000 Christmas bonus cards. Each card is worth 1,500 pesos and is linked to the beneficiary's ID.
why: Government cash-transfer programs inject spending into household consumption and are an element of fiscal policy. Fraud controls determine how efficiently that spending reaches recipients.
original_headline: Nuevas medidas de seguridad para Bono Navideño República Dominicana
